verdict.rationale: Usage metering is a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers invoices, recurring invoices, time logging, expenses and a general REST API limited to 100 requests per minute. It shows no usage-event ingestion endpoint, metering pipeline, idempotency keys or backdated event support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support
